subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: Should issue #53600 be scoped as a bounded native-Linux Gateway latency runbook, as new instrumentation work first, or closed as support-only guidance?
rationale: The repository has partial diagnostics already, but the requested output depends on maintainer intent for target environment, acceptable evidence, and whether this belongs as docs/runbook versus runtime instrumentation.

options.title: Publish a bounded runbook
options.body: Use current telemetry and docs to produce an investigation runbook first, then open narrow PRs only for measured missing spans or fixes.

options.title: Instrument missing spans first
options.body: Prioritize additional runtime diagnostics before writing the end-to-end VPS analysis, accepting that scope may broaden across several subsystems.

options.title: Close as support guidance
options.body: Treat this as environment-specific performance support rather than core work, leaving existing docs and related diagnostics PRs as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Publish a bounded runbook
recommendation.body: Use current telemetry and docs to produce an investigation runbook first, then open narrow PRs only for measured missing spans or fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is around cross-cutting agent runtime, performance cleanup, memory, and Telegram-related paths relevant to this investigation.
